issues.description: The template Main.java calls farm.feed(), but the problem statement and solution use the method name feedAllAnimals(). This mismatch in the expected Farm API (method name/signature) can confuse students about which method to implement and which method to call.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template Main.java consistent with the specification and solution. Change the call farm.feed(); in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java to farm.feedAllAnimals(); (or alternatively provide a farm.feed() method that delegates to feedAllAnimals()). Ensure the Farm API name matches the problem statement (feedAllAnimals()).

issues.description: The problem statement and solution expect the Farm method to be named feedAllAnimals(), but the template's example usage in Main.java calls farm.feed(). This inconsistent method name for the same conceptual action (feeding all animals) can confuse students when mapping the instructions to the provided starter code and the expected solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the template example with the problem and solution by replacing the call to farm.feed() with farm.feedAllAnimals() in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java, or alternatively provide a feed() wrapper in Farm that delegates to feedAllAnimals() and document it to avoid confusion.
